description.value: Maxine's Cafe & Bar is a neighbourhood restaurant and bar in Vancouver's West End whose interiors draw inspiration from the watering holes of Soho and the corner bistros of Europe. Executive Chef Bobby Milheron and Chef de Cuisine Paul Doonan lead a menu of elevated brunch, lunchtime, and dinner fare. Private dining for events is available, and the restaurant accepts walk-ins alongside reservations for dinner and weekday brunch.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces, covered) at 11m; wall_loops (3 spaces) at 29m; stands (4 spaces) at 85m. Total: 12 spaces.
